notes:
A correctly installed Meta pixel is no longer reported as unable to fire.

`mar.pixel_staged` raised a HIGH against a working pixel whose account id is
assigned to a variable and passed to the init call by name — what anyone does
when the same id is shared with a server-side conversions API. Docket matched
the id only *inside* the init call, so passing it by name read as an unfilled
placeholder.

The same root cause undercounted pixel coverage: with no page registering the
pixel at all, `mar.pixel_gaps` reported it on zero pages. Both are fixed by
resolving the id through the variable.

Still reported, deliberately: an identifier with no assignment anywhere, and one
assigned something that is not an id.
